Subject: Request: Onsite POC with Redwood — June/July window?

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs liked the latency stats. We'd like to run a 1-day onsite POC at your Novato HQ with a small hands-on workshop for our infra and product teams so we can validate the integration with our production-ish dataset. Target window: the week of Oct 18 or Oct 25 (we're flexible).

Practical asks up front:
- Is it possible to get a firewall test window so our infra team can verify egress and S3 connectivity to your test endpoints?
- We'll need NDAs signed ahead of time (I'll attach our vendor packet).
- Expect ~10–12 attendees (mix of infra, product, data scientists). Any max room capacity limits?
- Are there visitor parking passes or a shuttle recommendation from the closest hotel?

I've attached our vendor info and a short attendee list. Ops is cc'd for network specifics. Can you let me know a day that works and a single point of contact on your side?

Thanks,
Ari Cohen

Hi Ari — great to hear the execs liked the numbers. Happy to host. Quick notes and next steps: 

1) Dates: Oct 18 is tight for us (we have an all-hands). Oct 25 is much better — I'll tentatively reserve Conference Room A (capacity 14) and a breakout room. If you need bigger, tell me and I can check the Suite.

2) Network/firewall test: Karthik (cc'd) can coordinate a 2-hour test window the week prior. Karthik — can you scope what ports and IP ranges we need to open for their infra team?

3) NDAs: Please send your vendor NDA and we'll put our standard mutual non-disclosure up for signature. Monica — can you prep our NDA and the quick POC SOW template?

4) Logistics: Please ask attendees to pre-register 72 hours ahead for fast badging. We can provide 4 parking passes and recommend the Novato Marriott shuttle; I'll include details in the confirmation.

5) Data access: If Clearline wants to test with a representative dataset, we'll need a sanitized sample and a short data handling checklist we can review for privacy concerns.

I'll send a calendar invite once we lock the date and confirm the attendee count. If anything is urgent, reach me on my cell 415-555-0184.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
